result.title: AI-Assisted Tumor-Growth Law Discovery from Sparse Data: Refitting and LLM-Based Ranking
result.summary: Inferring tumor-growth laws from sparse, noisy observations requires more than accurate curve fitting. We study an AI-assisted workflow involving symbolic regression, mathematical admissibility checks, coefficient refitting, and large language model (LLM) ranking. Synthetic Gompertz data allow trajectory fit, forecasting, and recovery of the governing growth law to be assessed separately. A dense noiseless control recovers the generating family, but sparse noisy sampling frequently leads to alternative forms. Among retained candidates in the tested configurations, physics-informed neural network refitting often increases growth-law error, whereas classical nonlinear least squares usually reduces it. A separate exploratory analysis of archived LLM rankings shows no consistent improvement over selection by training error and identifies errors in mathematical reasoning. Plausible saturation, accurate trajectory fits, and convincing explanations can therefore coexist with incorrect growth laws. Mathematical validity and law recovery require evaluation alongside predictive performance.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作用符号回归、数学可容许性检查、系数重拟合与 LLM 排序，从稀疏含噪的肿瘤生长数据中推断生长律，并分别评估轨迹拟合、预测与真实机制恢复，发现轨迹拟合良好与生长律正确可以并存，LLM 排序未稳定优于按训练误差选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选假设排序＋拟合优度与机制正确性分离评价」的思路，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的筛选、以及答案正确与内部状态是否真正使用视觉证据的区分提供评价参照，需核查其可用性。
